normalized.result: Yes, that's the honest and right treatment. If the file I imported simply doesn't carry a saved date for something, I'd much rather it say "Date unavailable" than make up a date that looks real but isn't — a fake date could mislead me later or scramble my sense of when I actually found something. Being upfront that the history just isn't known is the trustworthy choice. And it makes sense to me that when I sort by newest or oldest, the ones with no known date settle together after all the dated ones, rather than jumping to the top or bottom pretending to be the newest or oldest. That keeps the ordering meaningful for the bookmarks that do have real dates. Settled.
